Street guides / 04

What kind of food does the sign suggest?

You can guess a restaurant's focus without reading every line of its menu.

Updated 2 October 2026

식당

Understand the place

식당 is a general word for a restaurant. Other signs name food or a style of eating: 김밥 is seaweed rice rolls, 국수 is noodles, and 분식 commonly points to casual Korean snacks and simple meals. 치킨 often signals a fried-chicken shop in a restaurant setting.

Easy to mix up

김밥 on a sign does not mean the shop sells only gimbap. 분식 is a category, not one dish. A sign can suggest a specialty, but it cannot tell you every ingredient or whether an item suits your dietary needs. Check the menu or ask the staff for those details.

A sign you might see

A storefront reads 김밥 · 분식. Expect a casual food place and start looking for the menu, rather than treating the two words as the name of a single meal. If you see 국수 nearby, you have spotted another food clue: noodles.

Read in this order

  1. Decide whether the sign names a place, a category, or a dish. 식당 is a place word, 분식 a food category, and 김밥 a dish.
  2. Read neighboring food words as separate clues. A board may advertise several specialties; it need not name one combined dish.
  3. Use the sign to find the menu. Ingredients, portions, prices, and dietary suitability need their own information, not a guess from the shop's category.

Three signs, three decisions

Fictional sign examples

김밥 · 분식

김밥 and 분식 together suggest a casual food place serving items such as gimbap. They do not form one dish name. Look at the actual menu to discover what else the fictional shop offers.

국수 · 식당

국수 gives a food clue—noodles—and 식당 gives a place clue—restaurant. The combination helps you find a noodle meal, but it does not specify the broth, toppings, or portion. Those belong to the individual item.

치킨 · 휴무

치킨 suggests a chicken-focused restaurant in this scene, while 휴무 announces a day off or closure. Recognizing the food does not mean you can order it immediately. Check the status before planning your next stop.

What the sign cannot tell you

A 김밥 sign is not a complete ingredient list. It cannot establish that a roll is vegetarian or suitable for an allergy. Read the individual description or ask the staff. The useful skill here is finding the right type of place, then knowing which information is still missing.

Check your understanding

1. Which sign gives you a noodle clue?

Show answer and explanation

국수 means noodles. 김밥 is seaweed rice rolls and 치킨 is chicken. A noodle sign is a starting point for reading the restaurant's menu, not a complete description of the meal.

2. Does 분식 name one specific dish?

Show answer and explanation

No. 분식 describes a category of casual Korean snacks and simple food. The dishes offered are listed separately on the menu.

Try it on your next walk

Imagine you want noodles. Find 국수 among the signs, listen to it, and then try the food round. For a second challenge, explain the difference between 식당 and 김밥 in your own words.
